sources.text: Welcome! Our lab is headed by Professor Sujit Dey , who is also the Director of UC San Diego Center for Wireless Communications , and the Director of the Institute for the Global Entrepreneur . Our research projects aim towards enabling preventive and personalized healthcare, mobile immersive multimedia experiences, and smart and clean transportation solutions, through innovations in multi-modal sensor fusion, deep learning algorithms and architectures, edge computing, multimedia networking, and sustainable communications. Professor Dey has created inter-disciplinary programs involving multiple UCSD schools as well as community, city and industry partners; notably the Connected Health Program in 2016 and the Smart Transportation Innovation Program in 2018.
